How to Use Summer Essentials trio? 1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash Take adequate amount of bodywash in your palms/loofah. Apply on wet skin in a gentle circular motion. 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On Roll evenly on underarm skin and allow the product to dry completely. Ultralight Sunscreen On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck. Important Information Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4.
